title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 60
paragraphs: Another tripod speaks thus in hexameter verse:
“Me Scaeus offered to you, far-darting Apollo, victor in the boxing contest, a gift most fair in your honor.”

This Scaeus would be the son of Hippocoön (if indeed it was really he who offered it, and not another of the same name as the son of Hippocoön), being of an age contemporary with Oedipus, son of Laius.
